evidence: Growth rate has been investigated in detail as a function of various growth parameters. When arsine gas-pulse duration is increased, the growth rate decreases drastically once a film thickness [1 monolayer (ML) for GaAs( 100), (110), and (111 )B, 2 ML for AlAs(100) and (111 )B, and 3 ML for AIAs(1lO) J has been reached.
